reason: A DSH client and data plugin that replace the default web interface with a stock-market-themed dashboard for visualizing agent sessions, token usage, code changes, and workspace Git data.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 默认网页界面替换为同花顺风格的终端仪表盘，用于展示智能体会话、Token 消耗、代码变更和工作区 Git 数据。
summaries.en: Replaces the default DSH web interface with a stock-terminal-style dashboard for viewing agent sessions, token usage, code changes, and workspace Git data.

capabilities: Replaces the default DSH web interface with a stock-terminal-style workspace UI
Displays chat, trajectory, checkpoint, queue, token usage, code changes, git tree, and session data
Collects session token usage and tool-call data through a DSH data plugin
Reads workspace git commits, file trees, diffs, and line-change statistics
Exposes collected workspace metrics through a local snapshot endpoint
Provides workspace, session, model, and file-index search in the interface
